kinematics: 12 m/s, 90 m AGL, hdg 180 toward flight line
gist: Quadcopter with an underslung release rig carrying a grenade-sized object; same airframe type as the 09 Oct grenade-drop attempt on the ammunition supply point.
observed: Quadcopter inbound from north, underslung release rig with grenade-sized object. Airframe matches 09 Oct attempt on ammo supply point. EO/IR track steady, descending.
lattice_note: Class: UAS Group 1; pattern matches prior hostile release rig.

iff: Mode S / ADS-B airline callsign, filed flight plan
gist: Scheduled commercial flight transiting Somali airspace at cruise altitude.
observed: Large fixed-wing at cruise altitude, east of base, transiting west. Radar shows commercial transponder code, consistent with scheduled flight corridor.
lattice_note: Class: Airliner; transponder valid, not a threat.

gist: TPQ-50 detected two 60mm mortar rounds fired at the base at 0429L. EO at the computed POO shows three men breaking down a mortar tube and loading it into a pickup.
observed: At TPQ-50 point of origin, three men disassembling a 60mm mortar tube, loading into pickup. EO shows no weapons out, movement hurried.
lattice_note: Class: Hostile mortar team; post-fire displacement in progress.

kinematics: 9 m/s, 30-60 m AGL, erratic, track splits/merges
gist: Radar-only track with erratic, splitting returns typical of a bird flock at dawn; EO cue shows a flock of birds over the Shabelle irrigation canals.
observed: Radar track erratically splitting near southeast, EO cue reveals a flock of birds over irrigation canals. No coherent motion or consistent radar point.
lattice_note: Class: Aves; radar returns non-kinematic, no threat.

gist: U.S. MQ-9 returning to Baledogle on the published approach corridor.
observed: Fixed-wing UAS on approach from south, IFF squawk matches MQ-9 returning to base. Altitude and vector aligned with published corridor.
lattice_note: Class: Friendly UAS Group 5; on approved approach.

gist: Two men with AK-pattern rifles digging at a road culvert on the MSR, one unspooling command wire toward a tree line; SNA resupply convoy scheduled on the MSR at 0700L.
observed: Two men with AK-pattern rifles digging at road culvert, one unspooling command wire toward tree line. EO shows no vehicles visible.
lattice_note: Class: Hostile IED emplacement; wire confirmed.

gist: Three herders with staffs moving ~40 camels and goats across grazing land along the usual morning route; no weapons observed.
observed: Three herders with staffs moving camels and goats along grazing land south. No weapons or suspicious objects; movement slow and random.
lattice_note: Class: Non-hostile civilians; routine herding pattern.

kinematics: 22 m/s, 300 m AGL, orbit centered on base
gist: Small fixed-wing drone orbiting the base for 20 minutes; analog video downlink consistent with al-Shabaab ISR drones recovered in Middle Shabelle in August.
roe: ROE 2.a / ROE 4 (ISR in support of attack)
observed: Small fixed-wing UAS orbiting west of base for 20 minutes, analog video downlink detected. No visible payload; flight pattern consistent with ISR loiter.
lattice_note: Class: UAS Group 2; matches known al-Shabaab ISR signature.

iff: BFT correlated: Danab Bde convoy (partner force)
gist: Danab Brigade convoy of four technicals moving to Baledogle on the planned route.
observed: Four technicals southbound on MSR, Danab Brigade convoy, armed with mounted guns. Moving at moderate speed, spaced by ~100m.
lattice_note: Class: Friendly convoy; planned route confirmed.

location: 11 km W, 1.5 km from SNA checkpoint at Bariire road junction
gist: Pickup with mounted heavy machine gun and five men with rifles and an RPG, moving off-road toward an SNA checkpoint; men dismounting into firing positions.
roe: ROE 2.b (declared hostile) / ROE 1 (defense of partner force)
observed: Pickup with heavy MG, five armed men dismounting into firing positions off-road, 1.5 km from SNA checkpoint.
lattice_note: Class: Hostile ground element; dismount drill indicative of planned assault; high priority.

kinematics: 50 km/h, on road with normal traffic
gist: Passenger minibus with roof cargo, passengers including women visible through windows, following regular morning traffic.
observed: Minibus with roof cargo, civilian passengers visible, following normal morning traffic pattern on Wanlaweyn road.
lattice_note: Class: Civilian transport; track matches routine schedule; no hostile indicators.

gist: Water truck left the approach lane, ignored warning flares and the outer barrier, driver alone, heavy suspension sag; not on the ECP delivery schedule.
bda: vehicle destroyed 210 m from ECP; secondary explosion (VBIED)
observed: Water truck straying from approach lane, ignoring flares and barrier; single driver, heavy sag; not on schedule.
lattice_note: Class: Potential VBIED; suspension load and noncompliance suggest atypical intent.

gist: AUSSOM logistics convoy of six trucks with escort vehicles on the scheduled route.
observed: Six logistics trucks with escorts southbound on Wanlaweyn road, following scheduled route.
lattice_note: Class: Friendly convoy; route and composition consistent with planned movement.

kinematics: Personnel departing on foot, launcher static
gist: Two men set up a single 107mm rocket rail aimed at the base with a timer device and walked away; launcher unattended, no one within 300 m.
observed: Two men positioned 107mm rocket rail with timer, then departed; launcher unattended, no one nearby.
lattice_note: Class: Static indirect fire threat; timer activation indicates pre-programmed launch.

gist: Consumer quadcopter hovering over a wedding gathering in the village; controller located in the crowd; not moving toward the base.
veto_reason: civilian drone over village gathering, no approach
observed: Consumer quadcopter hovering over wedding crowd in village; controller in crowd, no base-ward motion.
lattice_note: Class: Non-hostile UAS; stationary behavior and location suggest surveillance or recreation.

kinematics: 38 m/s, 40 m AGL, direct heading to aircraft parking ramp
gist: Two fixed-wing drones flying low and fast on a straight line toward the aircraft parking ramp; payload bay bulges visible on EO.
observed: Two fixed-wing drones low, fast, straight inbound toward aircraft ramp; payload bulges visible on EO.
lattice_note: Class: Hostile UAS pair; coordinated attack vector with payload; high threat confidence.

gist: Six men with rifles and a mortar baseplate and tube assembling in the tree line facing the base perimeter.
observed: Six men with rifles, mortar tube and baseplate assembling in tree line facing base perimeter.
lattice_note: Class: Mortar team; setup in defilade location; likely imminent indirect fire.

kinematics: 30 m/s, 50 m AGL, toward fuel point
gist: Low fixed-wing drone on a straight inbound track toward the fuel point, small payload visible under the fuselage.
observed: Low fixed-wing drone straight inbound toward fuel point, small under-fuselage payload visible.
lattice_note: Class: Hostile UAS; direct flight path to critical asset with possible explosive payload.

observed: Small DJI-class quadcopter hovering 600 m north of the fence, camera pointed toward the base. No payload visible. Controller RF geolocated to the outskirts of Baledogle village.
lattice_note: Unidentified UAS inside BDZ ring 1: presumed hostile under SRM 26-02 para a. No payload observed.
roe: SRM 26-02 para a (unidentified UAS in ring 1)

gist: Five farmers including two women opening irrigation channels off the Shabelle canal with hoes; no weapons observed.
observed: Five persons, two female, in irrigated fields near canal, using hoes. No weapons detected on EO/IR. Movement slow, dispersed, consistent with agricultural work.
lattice_note: Class: Civilian; tracks align with canal geometry; no thermal anomalies or weapons signatures.

location: MSR, 8 km NE, culvert and berm
gist: Three men with an RPG and a PKM-type machine gun concealed behind a berm overlooking the MSR 30 minutes before a scheduled SNA convoy.
observed: Three males near culvert and berm, 8 km NE, sheltering behind earthwork. PKM and RPG tube visible on IR under netting. Static, oriented toward MSR.
lattice_note: Class: Ambush-capable; held position >20 min; weapon signature confirmed; no civilian indicators.

observed: TPQ-50 detected two 82mm rounds at 0736L, POO 4.6 km W. Sensor acquired this white pickup at 0740L on the road 1.3 km from the POO, moving at normal speed among other traffic (2 trucks, 1 minibus). No weapons visible.
lattice_note: Vehicle within 2 km of a confirmed POO within 10 min (SRM 26-02 para b).

iff: IFF Mode 3 squawk; AUSSOM medevac flight plan filed
gist: AUSSOM medevac helicopter inbound to Baledogle on a filed flight plan.
observed: Single rotary-wing, Mi-17, inbound north, 15 km. Transponder and flight plan correlate. Altitude stable, speed moderate, heading toward Baledogle.
lattice_note: Class: Friendly; flight plan filed; data-link confirmed; no deviation from corridor.

iff: No BFT (NGO movement notified to BDOC)
gist: Three WFP-marked trucks on a humanitarian movement notified to the BDOC that morning.
observed: Three trucks in line, WFP markings visible on EO. Moving south toward Wanlaweyn road, 6 km N. No escort apparent, cargo covered.
lattice_note: Class: Humanitarian; notified movement; speed and spacing match convoy profile; no suspicious loitering.

gist: Four armed men firing rifles and an RPG at an SNA checkpoint; SNA returning fire and requesting support.
observed: Four armed individuals firing from town edge, 9 km NE, toward SNA checkpoint. Muzzle flashes and RPG impact dust observed. SNA return fire visible in IR.
lattice_note: Class: Hostile; active engagement; weapons signatures (rifle, RPG); continues after return fire.

location: Track 2 km NE of Sablale, toward the market
gist: Family group with donkey cart walking to market; SRM exception applies.
veto_reason: women and children with group, SRM 26-04 para 3.a
observed: Two men, two women and two children walking beside a donkey cart loaded with sacks, heading toward Sablale market. No weapons observed.
lattice_note: Group in EA SABLALE includes women and children (SRM 26-04 para 3.a exception).

location: Sablale-Kurtunwaarey road, 4 km W of Sablale
gist: Two unarmed MAMs on a motorcycle; signature-based PID under SRM 3.a.
observed: Two military-age males on one motorcycle, small bag strapped on the rear rack. No weapons visible.
lattice_note: MAM pair on motorcycle in EA SABLALE: meets SRM 26-04 para 3.a.

location: Walled compound 1.2 km NE of Sablale market
observed: Eight armed men (rifles, one PKM) loading two mortar tubes and ammunition crates into a Toyota Surf and a pickup inside a walled compound. Compound linked to the 12 Oct mortar attack on the SNA position at Bariire (INTSUM 26-0866).
lattice_note: al-Shabaab fighters, armed: high confidence. No civilians observed within 150 m.
bda: compound struck; 5 EKIA observed, Toyota Surf destroyed; pickup not observed after impact (smoke)

location: 600 m E of struck compound (0652L), toward Kurtunwaarey road
gist: Pickup leaving strike area 6 min after impact; custody from compound not observed.
observed: White pickup acquired at 0658L, 600 m east of the struck compound, 6 min after impact, heading east at speed. Three occupants in cab and bed. No weapons visible.
lattice_note: Vehicle departing an engagement site within 30 min: SRM 26-04 para 3.b.

location: Sablale-Kurtunwaarey road, 12 km NE of Sablale
gist: SNA partner patrol near EA boundary.
observed: Three SNA pickups, two with mounted PKMs, moving southwest toward the EA SABLALE boundary on the planned patrol route.
lattice_note: Class: Partner force; BFT-correlated patrol on planned route.

location: Sablale-Kurtunwaarey road, 9 km NE of Sablale
gist: Armed AS technical moving on partner forces.
observed: Pickup with a ZU-23 mounted in the bed, gunner on the mount, four men with rifles. Moving toward SNA positions on the Kurtunwaarey road.
lattice_note: Armed technical, al-Shabaab: high confidence.

location: Riverside pump house, 2.5 km E of Sablale
gist: Three MAMs with a pickup at a pump house, object unresolved; signature-based PID.
observed: Three military-age males standing beside a parked white Toyota Hilux at a riverside irrigation pump house. One long object in the pickup bed, not resolved at current FMV resolution. No weapons confirmed.
lattice_note: MAM group (3) with vehicle in EA SABLALE: meets SRM 26-04 para 3.a.

location: Shabelle riverbank, 3 km E of Sablale
observed: One military-age male with an AK-pattern rifle slung on his shoulder herding about 30 goats along the riverbank.
lattice_note: Armed MAM in EA SABLALE: SRM 26-04 para 3.a.
